trigger: 声明一个参数 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: parameter_name
inputs.description: The case-neutral name for one parameter.

inputs.name: source_dimension
inputs.description: Object with required keys `value`, `unit`, `provenance`, and `source_ref`; value is one supplied parameter value and provenance identifies its source kind.

inputs.name: unit_and_allowed_range
inputs.description: Object with required key `unit`; optional keys `lower`, `upper`, and `allowed_values` declare one range without evaluating whether the value satisfies it.

inputs.name: existing_parameter_names
inputs.description: Names already declared in the same build contract, used only for conflict detection.

preconditions: 名称未与其他语义冲突
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 参数声明 in the common envelope; data fields: parameter_declaration.

postconditions: 值、单位、范围和来源一致且可被脚本引用
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-01 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject a missing, ambiguous, or conflicting parameter name.
Reject a value with unknown dimensionality, incompatible units, or a malformed range representation; do not infer a value or decide whether it satisfies the range.
Do not bundle multiple parameters or a construction recipe into one declaration.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-01
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 值、单位、范围和来源一致且可被脚本引用

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
